notes.title: Release Schmelease
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Slingerinos,


after all over more than 4 years of prototyping, brainstorming, developing and discarding many many options Sling-A-Thing could have become - we are very proud, tired, exhausted to finally release our brand new game today!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779634/d9a3a0ac34ef78f660a445a42f5685af77d44241.png"]

Thanks for all of you to support us on the way - no matter whether it was through playtesting, kind words, lighthearted kick up the backsides or even contract work so we could even work on such a project.

Have fun slinging you way through all our hand-crafted levels, achieve the challenges we put together and - what matters the most: enjoy the quirkiness!



Tschüsseldorf, Thomas & Fabian
